verse.verse_1: A beseecher besought the visitation of chastisement,
verse.verse_2: (a chastisement meant) for the unbelievers, one which none can avert;
verse.verse_3: a chastisement from Allah, the Lord of the ascending steps,
verse.verse_4: by which the angels and the Spirit ascend to Him in one Day the duration of which is fifty thousand years.
verse.verse_5: So, (O Prophet), persevere with gracious perseverance.
verse.verse_6: Verily they think that the chastisement is far off,
verse.verse_7: while We think that it is near at hand.
verse.verse_8: It shall befall on a Day whereon the sky will become like molten brass,
verse.verse_9: and the mountains will become like dyed tufts of wool,
verse.verse_10: and no bosom friend will enquire about any of his bosom friends
verse.verse_11: although they shall be within sight of one another. The guilty one would fain ransom himself from the torment of that Day by offering his children,
verse.verse_12: and his spouse and his brother,
verse.verse_13: and his kinsfolk who had stood by him,
verse.verse_14: and all persons of the earth, if only he could thus save himself.
verse.verse_15: By no means! It will be the fierce flame
verse.verse_16: that will strip off the scalp.
verse.verse_17: It shall insistently summon him who turned his back and retreated,
verse.verse_18: and amassed wealth and covetously hoarded it.
verse.verse_19: Verily man is impatient by nature:
verse.verse_21: and tight-fisted when good fortune visits him,
verse.verse_23: and are constant in their Prayer;
verse.verse_24: and those in whose wealth there is a known right
verse.verse_25: for those that ask and those that are dispossessed,
verse.verse_26: those who firmly believe in the Day of Recompense,
verse.verse_27: and fear the chastisement of their Lord –
verse.verse_28: surely the chastisement of their Lord is a thing none can feel secure from –
verse.verse_29: and those who guard their private parts,
verse.verse_30: except in regard to their spouses and those whom their right hands possess, for in regard to them they are not reproachable,
verse.verse_31: but any who seeks to go beyond that, it is indeed they who are the transgressors,
verse.verse_32: and those who fulfil their trusts and their covenants,
verse.verse_33: and those who are upright in their testimonies;
verse.verse_34: and who take due care of their Prayer:
verse.verse_35: all these shall live honourably in the Gardens.
verse.verse_36: But what is the matter with the unbelievers who are hurrying towards you
verse.verse_37: in crowds, both on the right and on the left?
verse.verse_38: Does everyone of them wish to enter the Garden of Bliss?
verse.verse_39: By no means! They know that which We have created them from.
verse.verse_40: I swear by the Lord of the easts and the wests that We have the power
verse.verse_41: to replace them by others who would be better than they; and We shall certainly not be overpowered.
verse.verse_42: So leave them to engage in vain talk and to amuse themselves until they come face to face with the Day which they are promised,
verse.verse_43: the Day on which they will hastily come forth from their graves, as though they were hurrying on to the altars of their deities.
verse.verse_44: Their eyes will be downcast and disgrace will overwhelm them. Such is the Day that they were promised.
